acceptance: Original quarter condition: Origin mean absolute change >=0.10 and repair <=0.01 on same complete primary constructed cohort; report CI, per-case joint success, >=0.20 count, coverage, worst deltas and positive subject controls. All missing values and rejected candidates retained. Subject sensitivity requires a mean signed drop >=0.05 on the complete same primary cohort, not merely positive signs. Report negligible |drop|<=0.01, wrong direction, >0.01, >=0.05, >=0.10 counts and joint background-plus-subject case success with every missing item retained.
artifact_binding: After construction only, fill dataset_index_sha256, expected_constructed, expected_review_qualified and integrity hash from completed receipts. Scoring parameters and cohort cannot change. Known semantic exclusion is applied only if that UID is numerically accepted; otherwise it remains construction-rejected. Bind this intersection before scores.
capacity: Use CPU 8 workers and physical GPUs 1 and 5. Do not interrupt unrelated jobs. Check free storage before construction.
claim_limit: All official natural videos/preferences were previously exposed. The census is broader coverage of a fixed method, not a wholly unseen independent confirmation. Report prior explicit intervention-development prompt groups and grouped follow-up separately.
construction: Fresh SegFormer-B0 ADE20K + initial GrabCut + optional 25% extent recovery; valid-initial fallback unified with previously validated cached recovery. Every native frame; unchanged 1%-50% per-frame gates.
review: Coarse input diagnostics, paced one example at a time. Retain all numerical results; no new score-based removal. No pixel-perfect human contour claim.
